changelog:
Initial public release: Expert guide for buying the right generator.

- Assesses user needs based on appliances, location, outage situation, and fuel availability.
- Calculates precise running and surge wattage requirements using load-sizing formulas.
- Provides region-aware, safety-conscious generator specs (wattage, fuel type, voltage, frequency, and safety features).
- Guides users through a friendly, detailed Q&A — no brand bias, fits residential and light-duty use.
- Helps avoid undersized or oversized purchases; aimed at independent, confident buying decisions.
summary: Help users buying a generator calculate running watts, surge watts, and fuel type from their appliances, outage situation, and location — load-sizing formula...
